clips.text: GLUB! HA! You got me! I see everybody. I never saw you!
clips.script: [startled, then roaring with laughter] GLUB! HA! You GOT me! [amazed] I see everybody. I never saw YOU!

clips.text: Hot dishes on the left. Everyone got the diagram.
clips.script: [crisp, defensive] Hot dishes on the left. [flat, firm] Everyone got the DIAGRAM.

clips.text: I know. They're going to start a newsletter.
clips.script: [dry, resigned] I know. [deadpan] They're going to start a newsletter.

clips.text: Tom. That's a turntable. They used to spin a whole streetcar on that.
clips.script: [mellow, hushed, thrilled] tom. that's a turntable. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, reverent, quiet] they used to spin a whole streetcar on that.

clips.text: That's Boppy. He's here every single day.
clips.script: [surprised] That's Boppy. [plain] He's here every single day.

clips.text: Take the pan. The sneaky one gets this. It's the only thing I've got.
clips.script: [huge, gentle] Take the pan. The sneaky one gets this. [plain, a little shy] It's the only thing I've got.

clips.text: If I could have your attention. The Watch would like to thank the Watch for arranging the bread.
clips.script: [formal, tapping a glass] If I could have your attention. [grand, flat] The Watch would like to thank the Watch for arranging the bread.

clips.text: It ran toward the boulevard, and it was on fire.
clips.script: [puzzled, plain] It ran toward the boulevard, [flat, bewildered] and it was on FIRE.

clips.text: I need about an hour. But go ahead.
clips.script: [mellow, dreamy] i need about an hour. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, easy, generous] but go ahead.

clips.text: The fish ate them, Boppy. The last three.
clips.script: [plain, reporting] The fish ate them, Boppy. The last three.

clips.text: The man in the folding chair. Will he be back?
clips.script: [huge, careful, hopeful] The man in the folding chair. Will he be back?

clips.text: Our pilot light just walked out of the house.
clips.script: [stunned, flat] Our pilot light just WALKED out of the house.

clips.text: It's a wet blanket. I'm not making a joke. Look at it.
clips.script: [mellow, earnest] it's a wet blanket. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, easy, deadpan] i'm not making a joke. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, calm] look at it.

clips.text: Tata, you have a job. If you see anything grey in California, or an orange cube, you write it down and text me.
clips.script: [bossy, serious] Tata, you have a JOB. If you see anything grey in California, or an orange cube, you write it down and text me.

clips.text: Good. He was in the middle of a story. The one about the race.
clips.script: [relieved] Good. He was in the middle of a story. The one about the race.

clips.text: We have forty loaves of raw dough and no fire.
clips.script: [tense, level] We have forty loaves of raw dough and NO fire.

clips.text: Hi. We can hear you.
clips.script: [mellow, polite] hi. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, easy, amused] we can hear you.

clips.text: That's my second best one. Don't lose it.
clips.script: [reluctant, sideways] That's my second best one. [firm] Don't LOSE it.

clips.text: Every flame on the block walked out. We're following them.
clips.script: [urgent, plain] Every flame on the block walked out. [steady] We're following them.

clips.text: You've got a flame in there. You could warm something up.
clips.script: [mellow, helpful] you've got a flame in there. [mellow, laid-back, low-key, easy, practical] you could warm something up.
